name: @pipeworx/mcp-patent-maintenance-fees

tools.name: get_patent_maintenance_status
tools.description: Look up a US patent's maintenance-fee history and in-force/expired status: every recorded maintenance-fee event (payments, surcharges, expiration for non-payment, reinstatement, entity-status changes) plus a computed status and a 4th/8th/12th-year fee-window breakdown (due date, grace-period end, whether paid). Give the patent number with or without commas ("10835610" or "10,835,610"). Design (D-prefixed) and plant (PP-prefixed) patents are statutorily exempt from maintenance fees and will report subject_to_maintenance_fees:false rather than a bare no-match. Sourced from USPTO's Patent Maintenance Fee Events (public domain, covers patents granted 1981-09-01 to present), refreshed from the weekly bulk file — every response carries data_as_of. Keyless. Does NOT determine full-term (20-year) expiration or any non-fee reason a patent could be invalid — this pack covers maintenance-fee lapses only; pair with the `patents` pack for prosecution history.

patent_number.description: US patent number, with or without commas, e.g. "10835610" or "10,835,610". Reissue numbers keep their "RE" prefix, e.g. "RE12345".

tools.name: search_maintenance_fee_events
tools.description: Search USPTO maintenance-fee events across patents by event code, patent-number prefix, and/or event-date range — e.g. all 'EXP.' (expired for non-payment) events in a date window. Returns an exact total_matching count first, then a capped sample of the actual event rows (newest first) — never a bare empty array on zero matches; the filters tried are always echoed back. Sourced from USPTO's Patent Maintenance Fee Events (public domain); every response carries data_as_of. Keyless.

event_code.description: Exact USPTO event code, e.g. "EXP." (expired, non-payment), "EXPX" (reinstated), "M1551" (4th-year large-entity payment).

patent_number_prefix.description: Patent-number prefix, e.g. "10835" or "RE4". Digits only unless a reissue "RE" prefix.

date_from.description: Event date lower bound, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Event date upper bound, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Max sample rows to return (default 50, max 200).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-patent-maintenance-fees forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the patent-maintenance-fees pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
